items.briefing:
Bitdefender has issued a warning for the Asia-Pacific region, including Australia, about a rise in scams targeting schools and students as the academic year gets underway. These scams often impersonate educational institutions or offer fake scholarships and enrolment deals to trick people into handing over personal details or money. Staff and students at your RTO should be cautious about unexpected emails or messages claiming to be from schools or training providers.

Separately, Abnormal AI has introduced improved email phishing detection and staff training tools, a reminder that phishing remains one of the most common ways organisations are compromised. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email about enrolments, fees, or course offers — even if it looks official — verify it by calling the organisation directly before clicking any links.
